title: OpenClaw for executives: Automate every 1% annoyance | Ankit Maheshwari (Innovaccer)
summary: Innovaccer CTO demonstrates how executives use OpenClaw to automate minor tasks
detailed: Innovaccer CTO Ankit Maheshwari shared his implementation of a custom OpenClaw Jarvis running on a Mac Mini to automate executive tasks.
The system handles workflows ranging from flight approvals and meal ordering to Slack nudges and smart home controls.
The architecture utilizes scoped subagents for specific tasks like email triage and health coaching rather than a single global agent.
This matters for technical leaders looking to build trustworthy personal automation workflows with strict guardrails and soul files.
sentences: Ankit Maheshwari, the CTO of Innovaccer, walks me through the OpenClaw Jarvis he still runs on a Mac Mini.

He started with the approvals that were making him the bottleneck at work, then kept going until the same system was ordering his lunch, calling coworkers who haven’t responded on Slack, negotiating restaurant reservations, and turning on the AC before he gets home.
